description: Atlas Method v2 - operator command definitions. Single source of truth for method slash commands. Generate runner-specific overlays from this file via: atlas adapters generate [--runner claude|grok|all]. Never hand-edit the generated output files.

forward.description: Pre-compact handoff. Distills for the next chat - catches scratchpad up, writes compact, prints paste-ready successor prompt. Does NOT seal (wrap seals: baton + worktree gc + push).
steps: Resolve domain: infer from newest session file today, or accept {domain} arg
Catch scratchpad up: compare to conversation; append any missing decisions, results, next steps
Load just enough spine: read personality and trunk paths from the domain command; direct-read those two files only; no Stage 1 scouts
Write compact: successor-orientation doc at sessions/current/{DOMAIN}-compact.md with sections: Mode, Live-do-not-undo, Ship-order-locked, Hard-no, Key-files, Host-notes
Update domain QUEUE: Quick Resume + NEXT CHAT pointer to compact; check off finished work
Print paste-ready successor prompt and stop

compact_aware_start.trigger: session opened with a named compact file
compact_aware_start.not_skip: Any file the work needs, including files the compact Key-files list names. Compact-aware is not file-blind.
compact_aware_start.note: Successor may load needed files - the compact tells WHERE the work is, not what to ignore.

forward.scope_boundary: forward distills, wrap seals. Forward writes the compact. Wrap writes the baton. Neither does the other's job.
forward.context_economics: Aim near 200k tokens. Tokens double past that. Auto-compact often fires at 400k+. /forward is how the operator hops before the expensive zone.

claude.format: flat .md file in .claude/commands/ (filename stem = command name)
claude.description_field: description frontmatter - shown in command palette

grok.format: flat .md file in .grok/commands/ (filename stem = slash command name; confirmed: skills doc section on command discovery)
